## Core Manufacturing Capabilities & Verticals
Shree Ram And Company Vijeta Stone operates direct manufacturing workshops in Jaipur, combining generational hand-chiseling craftsmanship with modern 5-axis CNC diamond router machinery.

1. **Stone Carving & 3D Architectural Wall Panels**
   - High-relief and bas-relief murals, double-height foyer wall carvings, living room feature backdrops, peacock and floral motifs.
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/stone-carving/

2. **Marble Temples & Sacred Mandirs**
   - Pure Makrana white marble home mandirs, community temple architecture, carved shikharas, sanctum sanctorum (garbhagriha), and Vastu Shastra compliant spiritual spaces.
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/marble-temple/
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/stone-temple/

3. **CNC Stone Jali & Architectural Screens**
   - 35mm to 50mm thick natural sandstone and marble perforated screens, facade sunshades, privacy lattices, haveli jharokhas, and balcony railings.
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/stone-jali/
   - Also manufacturing: MDF/HDMR jalis (https://shreeramandcompany.com/mdf-jali/), WPC waterproof jalis (https://shreeramandcompany.com/wpc-jali/), and partition dividers (https://shreeramandcompany.com/partition-jali/).

4. **Pietra Dura Marble Inlay Art & Luxury Table Tops**
   - Semi-precious stone inlay (lapis lazuli, malachite, mother of pearl, jasper, carnelian) into Makrana marble dining tables, center coffee tables, and floor medallions.
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/marble-inlay/
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/marble-table-tops/

5. **Natural Stone Water Fountains**
   - Outdoor tiered fountains, Baradari courtyard centerpieces, cascading lotus pools, and indoor wall water features in pink sandstone and white marble.
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/water-fountain/

6. **Exterior Stone Elevation & Wall Cladding**
   - Monolithic columns, carved pillars, Rajasthani arches (mehrabs), garden gazebos, balustrades, and weather-resistant sandstone facade cladding.
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/elevation-facade/
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/wall-cladding/
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/pillar/
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/gazebo/
   - URL: https://shreeramandcompany.com/arch-mehrab/

## Natural Stones Used
- **Makrana Pure White Marble**: Non-porous, calcium-rich, lifelong durability for temples and statues.
- **Bansi Paharpur Pink Sandstone**: Iconic Rajasthan sandstone renowned for heritage temple architecture.
- **Dholpur Beige & Chocolate Sandstone**: Fine-grained, weather-hardy exterior cladding stone.
- **Gwalior Mint Sandstone**: Dense, uniform quartzitic stone ideal for CNC jali cutouts.
- **Red Agra Stone & Jaisalmer Yellow Stone**: Warm, traditional royal Rajasthani stones.

## Factory Direct Ordering & Worldwide Shipping
- Factory-direct model with zero showroom markups.
- Pre-assembly at workshop to verify joint tolerances before dispatch.
- Fumigated ISPM-15 certified wooden crating with EPE foam cushioning and all-risk transit insurance.
- Door-to-door freight across Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, and export sea/air freight to USA, UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia.
